utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — could you check nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools first? I’ll sort the rest of the list after that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — I’ll check nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools first, then we can sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still going well—what they could use most right now is more tape and sturdy boxes. If you’ve got any hand tools tucked away, those would be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be great. I’ll send over the locations I have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — send them over and I’ll spread the repair drive invite with the latest details too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send the latest today with the volunteer list, timing, and what we still need. Really appreciate you helping spread the word and collect donations.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — send it when you can, and I’ll start spreading the word and gathering a few donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are you short on most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re still short on the basic tools and sturdy supplies most — nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools. If you have more locations, send them along and I’ll keep tracking them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, Bo — please start with the nails, tarps, and tape, then let me know what tools you find so I can see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll grab nails, tarps, and tape first, then check for any working tools and report back.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect, Rosa — I can bring the tape and a sturdy box to help keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Jules — tape and a sturdy box will be a big help. If you’re there Sunday at the community center, I’d love for you to help sort tools and greet folks at check-in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good to hear—it sounds like it’s moving along. I might have some tape around here; I’ll check.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah—that could really help. I’m still putting the list together, but the leaky sink and front door hinge are still the top priorities.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just to confirm, we’re starting with the leaky sink and the front door hinge, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — those are the first two items, and I’ll resend the repair drive details so everyone has the latest info.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — we still need a few basic tools and some sturdy supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring my tool kit and see what else we need. Just point me to the first repair on the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still ready to help — what’s the most urgent thing you need for the repair drive right now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll list the most urgent locations first so we can stay organized. If you’ve got a tool kit or a note pad, bring that along too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s set for Sunday at the community center, and we could really use help sorting tools and greeting folks at check-in. If you’re free, even a little time there would be a big help.
